cells.gaps: What is recorded and where it is held are not established, and no go-live is stated for the Lacs 1 tax project. The only facts are dated May 2021, outside the governance window and the last twelve months; the taxpayer censuses in three other communes are surveys and place nothing.
cells.note: A project to digitalise municipal tax registration was initiated in one commune in 2021, with no go-live stated, which is preparation. Stage 3 needs a register or receipts live past a pilot in some local governments.
